brief: Slovak domestic press coverage of banking personnel and restructuring splits into three tiers. The primary tier is the wires and the people-columns: SITA's financial desk (sita.sk/vofinanciach) with its 'personalne zmeny' tag archive, TASR via teraz.sk, and Pravda's dedicated ekonomika/ludia column — all open-web, dated and quotable, and the cheapest reliable feed for appointments. The analytical tier — TREND, HNonline, Index SME and Denník E/Denník N — carries the substantive reporting on layoffs, 'Fit to purpose'-style cost programmes and branch-network shrinkage, but is uniformly paywalled and, for TREND and HN, refused direct fetch in this pass (bot defence assumed, not death). Two non-obvious channels earn priority: the bank and insurance workers' union OZBP (ozbp.sk), which documents the sector collective-bargaining fight with the Slovak Banking Association and dismissals of union organisers that no bank announces, and the trade title FinReport.sk, whose keyword archives function as ready-made banking-people feeds. Below that sits a large low-credibility rewrite layer (Startitup, Topky, 24hod, Androidportal, Kryptomagazin) that is useful only for recall and salience, never for citation.
